player_0.content: I got stuck in a loop between the Dining room and Guest room, repeatedly moving north and south without ever exploring the east direction. I failed to recognize that the Lobby (which I visited earlier) was unreachable from the current path or that I needed to backtrack to a junction with unexplored options. Next time, I will immediately go east from the Guest room to access the Lobby and other unvisited areas. If I encounter a room with only one direction that leads back to a previously visited room, I will stop and declare DONE immediately, rather than attempting to move back and forth.
